body.says: Where one stands, said by what it means, and the field's programs as bricks to build where to look next, each built expression a press that rises to the mount.

drawn.says: The component the place is drawn by where it was pressed, whose settings it offers to set.

pressed.says: Whether it was laid where something was pressed: it takes the focus, and offers first what can be done there.

said.says: The settings the place's slot gave already, which no offer reaches, so are not offered to set.

body.title: Search
